# Plated

> Plated (App Store name "Plated: Gym & Calorie Tracker") is an iPhone app for food, lifting and running in one place: meals and macros, sets and personal records, GPS runs, and a social feed for sharing workouts with friends. It is made by Kaiser Axiom LLC.

## What is free

Plated is free to download. These are free: food logging, the barcode scanner, macro goals in grams, logging sets and personal records, GPS runs with splits, pace and elevation, Apple Health sync, up to 4 saved workout templates, importing workout history if your old app exports a CSV file, and the social feed (posting workouts and runs, following people, likes, comments, private profiles, PR stickers). Free accounts browse the last 60 days of workout history; everything logged is kept.

## Plated Pro

Plated Pro is an optional subscription: $9.99 a month or $59.99 a year in the US (prices as of November 2026), with a 7-day free trial, billed through Apple. It adds progressive overload suggestions (the next weight and reps, worked out from your history), training analytics and a muscle heatmap, the AI label scanner and AI food lookup, Fill My Macros dinner suggestions, micronutrients against the Daily Value, live heart rate from a strap or watch, the full workout history, comparing lifts with friends, and unlimited workout templates.

Calorie and macro targets in Plated are estimates from formulas and the numbers you enter. They are not medical or nutrition advice.
